entries.title: I Corinthians 11:1
segments: Be imitators of me, even as I also [am] of Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:2
segments: But I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and you keep the doctrines as I delivered [them] to you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:3
segments: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman [is] the man; and the head of Christ [is] God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:4
segments: Every man praying or prophesying with [his] head covered dishonors his Head.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:5
segments: But every woman who prays or prophesies with [her] head unveiled dishonors her head; for that is even the same as if she were shaved.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:6
segments: For if the woman is not veiled, let her also be shorn. But [if it] is a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be veiled.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:7
segments: For a man indeed ought not to have [his] head covered, because he is the image and glory of God. But the woman is [the] glory of [the] man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:8
segments: For the man is not of the woman, but the woman of the man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:9
segments: Nor was the man created for the woman, but the woman for the man.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:10
segments: For this reason the woman ought to have authority on [her] head because of the angels.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:11
segments: But neither is the man without the woman, nor the woman without the man, in the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:12
segments: For as the woman [is] of the man, even so the man [is] also by the woman; but all things of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:13
segments: Judge among yourselves: is it right that a woman pray to God unveiled?

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:14
segments: Does not even nature itself teach you that if man has long hair, it is a shame to him?

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:15
segments: But if a woman should have long hair, it is a glory to her; for her hair is given to her in place of a veil.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:16
segments: But if anyone seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor the churches of God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:17
segments: But in enjoining this, I do not praise [you], because you come together not for the better, but for the worse.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:18
segments: For first of all, when you come together in the church, I hear that there are divisions among you, and I partly believe it.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:19
segments: For there must also be heresies among you, that the approved ones may be revealed among you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:20
segments: Therefore when you come together into one place, [this] is not to eat [the] Lord's supper.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:21
segments: For in eating each one takes his own supper first; and one is hungry, and another drunken.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:22
segments: For do you not have houses [in which] to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God, and shame those who do not have? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? I do not praise [you]!

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:23
segments: For I received from the Lord what I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus in the night in which he was betrayed took bread;

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:24
segments: And giving thanks, He broke [it] and said, "Take, eat; this is My body, which is broken for you; this do in remembrance of Me."

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:25
segments: In the same way [He took] the cup also, after supping, saying, "This cup is the New Covenant in My blood; as often as you drink it, do this in remembrance of Me."

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:26
segments: For "as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you show" the Lord's death until He shall come.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:27
segments: So that whoever shall eat this bread and drink [this] cup of the Lord unworthily, he will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:28
segments: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of [that] bread and drink of that cup.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:29
segments: For he who eats and drinks unworthily eats and drinks condemnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:30
segments: For this cause many among you [are] weak and sickly, and many sleep.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:31
segments: For if we would judge ourselves, we would not be judged.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:32
segments: But when we are judged, we are chastened by [the] Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:33
segments: So that, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

entries.title: I Corinthians 11:34
segments: But if anyone hungers, let him eat at home, so that you do not come together to condemnation. And the rest I will set in order when I come.
